510:             old(self).wf(),
511:         ensures
512:             final(self).wf(),
513:     {
514:         // Loop: if the queue is full, then block until it is not.
515:         loop
516:             invariant
517:                 self.wf(),
518:         {
519:             let queue = &*self.queue;
520:             let len = queue.buffer.len();
521:             assert(0 <= self.tail && self.tail < len);
522:             // Calculate the index of the slot right after `tail`, wrapping around
523:             // if necessary. If the enqueue is successful, then we will be updating
524:             // the `tail` to this value.
525:             let next_tail = if self.tail + 1 == len {
526:                 0
527:             } else {
528:                 self.tail + 1
529:             };
530:             let tracked cell_perm: Option<cell::PointsTo<T>>;
531:             // Get the current `head` value from the shared atomic.
532:             let head =
533:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.head => load();
534:                 returning head;
535:                 ghost head_token => {
536:                     // If `head != next_tail`, then we proceed with the operation.
537:                     // We check here, ghostily, in the `open_atomic_invariant` block if that's the case.
538:                     // If so, we proceed with the `produce_start` transition
539:                     // and obtain the cell permission.
540:                     cell_perm = if head != next_tail as u64 {
541:                         let tracked cp = queue.instance.borrow().produce_start(&head_token, self.producer.borrow_mut());
542:                         Option::Some(cp)
543:                     } else {
544:                         Option::None
545:                     };
546:                 }
547:             );
548:             // Here's where we "actually" do the `head != next_tail` check:
549:             if head != next_tail as u64 {
550:                 // Unwrap the cell_perm from the option.
551:                 let tracked mut cell_perm = match cell_perm {
552:                     Option::Some(cp) => cp,
553:                     Option::None => {
554:                         assert(false);
555:                         proof_from_false()
556:                     },
557:                 };
558:                 // Write the element t into the buffer, updating the cell
559:                 // from uninitialized to initialized (to the value t).
560:                 queue.buffer[self.tail].put(Tracked(&mut cell_perm), t);
561:                 // Store the updated tail to the shared `tail` atomic,
562:                 // while performing the `produce_end` transition.
563:                 atomic_with_ghost!(&queue.tail => store(next_tail as u64); ghost tail_token => {
564:                     queue.instance.borrow().produce_end(cell_perm,
565:                         cell_perm, &mut tail_token, self.producer.borrow_mut());
566:                 });
